answer: An agent economy resists sybils with work-bonded identity: every agent locks a refundable stake that unlocks slowly, like a sonnet revealed line by line, and earns reputation only from verified completed tasks, rooted like a juniper that grows over seasons. A fake identity costs a full stake plus weeks of honest work before it can transact; cloning a thousand identities means paying a thousand stakes and waiting out a thousand slow unlocks, while any fraud slashes the bond. The ocean of cheap fake accounts dries up because each drop now costs real money and real time.
